comparison.position: 四层归一化映射用跨目标fuzzy loss锚定异构空间；native/mapped双分数联合取K，spoke最多经hub两次映射。
comparison.tradeoff: ECG-RAG让检索与压缩生成共享表示，HVMap不生成答案而对齐已存在的异构库。局部fuzzy loss与ECG联合loss均不代表完整RAG效果。

analysis.title: 共享一份表示与对齐多种表示，是不同的系统选择
analysis.body: ECG-RAG为避免重复存储而联合学习检索与压缩表示，依赖decoder训练；HVMap接受库已由不同编码器生成，通过配对映射和候选双空间评分消除部分不兼容。fuzzy loss对角锚定绝对对应，RKD只保相对几何不够；SCORE2还要保留每库native向量而不是总偏hub。小张量梯度不证明跨模态召回或索引吞吐，不能将完整campaign的作者结果搬进本地看板。

question.question: ECG式共享表示与HVMap的低fuzzy loss能共同证明RAG质量提升吗？
question.answer: 不能。两者改变不同链路且本地都缺完整训练/检索/答案评估；HVMap还须验证语义配对泛化与联合排序，ECG须验证压缩上下文生成。诊断loss不是端到端能力。
question.example: 教学例：反向传播成功并不说明一个相关文档进入top10，更不说明答案正确。

update.summary: 补HVMap跨空间fuzzy锚定、native权重与无配额联合检索；对照共享RAG表示，明确L1小张量与高成本完整实验的边界。

comparison.position: Four-layer normalized maps use cross-target fuzzy alignment; native/mapped scores merge global K, with at most two hub maps between spokes.
comparison.tradeoff: ECG-RAG shares retrieval and compressed-generation representations. HVMap aligns existing heterogeneous databases without answering questions. Local fuzzy and joint losses are not full RAG evidence.

analysis.title: Sharing one representation and aligning several are different system choices
analysis.body: ECG-RAG jointly learns retrieval/compression to avoid duplicate storage and still needs decoder training. HVMap accepts already heterogeneous encoders, using paired maps and two-space scoring. Fuzzy diagonal terms anchor absolute correspondence; relative RKD geometry is insufficient. SCORE2 retains each native vector rather than always favoring the hub. Small-tensor gradients establish neither cross-modal retrieval nor index throughput, so author campaign results must not become local dashboard claims.

question.question: Do ECG shared representations plus a low HVMap fuzzy loss prove better RAG?
question.answer: No. They change different stages, and local components lack complete training, retrieval and answer evaluation. HVMap needs semantic generalization and union rankings; ECG needs compressed-context generation. Diagnostic loss is not end-to-end capability.
question.example: Teaching example: successful backpropagation does not put a relevant document in top ten or make an answer correct.

english.update: Add HVMap cross-space anchors, native weights and quota-free merging, contrasted with shared RAG representations. Separate L1 tensor evidence from high-cost full campaigns.

comparison.position: 用原子参数补丁和受限practice反馈表达WSP接口，测试标签留在外部评价器，不用SGD替代推理编辑。
comparison.tradeoff: AMS从固定激活读出结构差异，不写参数也不认证安全；WSP问能否推理改权重。当前L0线性harness不含LLM、TinyEEGNet或被试数据。

analysis.title: 读出差异与修复能力不能靠同一个诊断标签混为一谈
analysis.body: AMS的方向/漂移是检测信号，存在结构保持攻击盲区；Mixed Signals的推理写权重还要求受限反馈和独立未见被试评价。原子写入、失败消耗预算和正确balanced accuracy是必要工程合同，却不创造会编辑的LLM。SGD违规替换和test反馈泄漏都改变了问题。完整campaign高成本不复现，保留L0接口与实际CUDA加载前向证据，不拿作者医学结果背书。

question.question: AMS检查通过、权重补丁接口也通过，能标成成功修复吗？
question.answer: 不能。AMS仅给激活结构诊断，接口仅给原子性/预算合同；修复需要真实推理编辑器在权限隔离的practice反馈下操作，并在未见被试上独立评价。
question.example: 教学例：把线性层取负确实改了forward，但不能当EEG模型准确率提高。

update.summary: 补WSP权重补丁、预算和评价接口，对照AMS检测而非编辑的边界；不调用LLM、不替代TinyEEGNet，完整实验高成本不复现。

comparison.position: Atomic patches and bounded practice feedback express the WSP interface; test labels remain external and SGD does not replace reasoning edits.
comparison.tradeoff: AMS reads fixed activations without editing or certifying safety. WSP asks about reasoning-based weight changes. The L0 linear harness has no LLM, TinyEEGNet or subject records.

analysis.title: Detecting a difference is not evidence of repair capability
analysis.body: AMS directions/drift are signals with structure-preserving attack blind spots. Mixed Signals additionally requires bounded editing feedback and independent unseen-subject evaluation. Atomicity, charged failures and balanced accuracy are necessary contracts, not an editing LLM. SGD substitution and test-feedback leakage change the task. High-cost campaigns are not reproduced; retain L0 and real CUDA loading/forward evidence without borrowing author medical results.

question.question: Do passing AMS and patch-interface checks establish successful repair?
question.answer: No. AMS supplies structural diagnostics and the interface supplies atomicity/budget contracts. Repair needs an actual reasoning editor under isolated practice feedback and independent unseen-subject evaluation.
question.example: Teaching example: negating a linear layer changes its forward pass, not necessarily EEG accuracy.

english.update: Add WSP patch, budget and evaluator interfaces against AMS's detection-not-editing boundary. No LLM or TinyEEGNet substitute; high-cost full experiments are not reproduced.
